summary: Frontend testing completed for GroupDashboard integration in MonTerritoireBionicPage. Fixed 2 critical bugs: 1) refreshGroups function reference error, 2) myGroups array access issue. All requested features verified working: Group dropdown menu, Create group dialog, GroupDashboard modal with Chat tab, Vibration toggle ON/OFF, and reduced scroll speed.

ui_bugs.issue: Dialog modal may have z-index issues - screenshots show dimmed background but tests confirm elements are present and clickable

issues: Minor ESLint warnings for unescaped entities in JSX (quotes and apostrophes)

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: useHuntingGroups hook returns 'refresh' but code was calling 'refreshGroups' - changed to 'refresh: refreshGroups' destructuring
FIXED: myGroups was an object {owned_groups: [], member_groups: []} but code used myGroups.length - changed to use 'allGroups: myGroups' which is the combined array
Good: Vibration toggle in GroupDashboard Chat tab is properly implemented with localStorage persistence
Good: Scroll speed reduction working correctly (SCROLL_STEP=40px for ArrowDown, 40% viewport for PageDown)
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/pages/MonTerritoireBionicPage.jsx - Fixed refreshGroups reference and myGroups array access
context_for_next_testing_agent: GroupDashboard integration is now working. The Group dropdown in MonTerritoireBionicPage shows 'Créer un groupe' option and lists user's groups under 'Mes groupes'. Clicking a group opens the GroupDashboard modal with Carte/Membres/Chat tabs. The Chat tab has a vibration ON/OFF toggle. Scroll speed is reduced to 40px per arrow key press.

group_dropdown_menu.notes: Dropdown opens from 'Groupe' button, shows 'Créer un groupe' and lists user's groups

create_group_dialog.notes: Dialog opens, accepts group name, creates group successfully with invite code

group_dashboard_modal.notes: Opens when clicking on a group, shows Carte/Membres/Chat tabs

vibration_toggle.notes: Toggle found in Chat tab with ON/OFF state, persists to localStorage

scroll_speed_reduction.notes: ArrowDown scrolls 40px (reduced from default ~100px), PageDown scrolls ~40% viewport

page_load.notes: Mon Territoire BIONIC page loads correctly with map and BIONIC zones

bugs_fixed.bug: TypeError: refreshGroups is not a function
bugs_fixed.cause: useHuntingGroups hook returns 'refresh' but code called 'refreshGroups'

bugs_fixed.bug: Groups not showing in dropdown after creation
bugs_fixed.cause: myGroups is object {owned_groups, member_groups} but code used myGroups.length
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed to use 'allGroups: myGroups' which is the combined array
